sn47.95-104:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā.
sn47.95-104:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.95-104:2.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.95-104:2.6: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbāti.
